components.name: Facet panel
components.description: Facet panel — filters for catalogue search, opened from the Filter slot of Search field. React: <FacetPanel device />. Web: popover with facet list on the left and Checkbox options with counts on the right, Clear all and a Show results button. Mobile: bottom-sheet content with grouped Checkbox options and a full-width apply button. Built from Checkbox and Button instances.
